subject: AWS Marketplace private offer — renewal & capacity increase for Acme Analytics
messages:
From: Sarah Dunne <sarah.dunne@aws-partner.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme-analytics.com
Date: Tue, 03 Feb 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: AWS private offer expiry + renewal steps for Acme Analytics

Hi Marissa,

Quick note — the Private Offer we published for Acme Analytics (PrivateOfferId: PO-987654) is scheduled to expire on 2026-02-12. Acme indicated they want to increase committed capacity (additional GPU hours + higher throughput tier) and extend the term from 12 to 24 months. When an external customer requests a term change + upsell, we need a revised seller quote + a PO that references the PrivateOfferId.

Can you provide:
- An updated price schedule reflecting the 24-month term and the capacity uplift (line-item breakout)
- A draft PO (PDF) or confirmation that Acme will submit a PO referencing PO-987654
- Any redlines to marketplace terms your legal team requires so we can coordinate acceptance on the AWS side

If we receive a PO and seller acceptance by 2026-02-10, I can hold the private offer open for an additional 10 days while we complete DocuSign. Otherwise AWS will automatically expire the offer and we have to republish.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Sarah
AWS Marketplace Partner Manager
AWS Partner Solutions

Attachment: AWS_PrivateOffer_Summary_PO-987654.pdf (stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Dunne <sarah.dunne@aws-partner.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, purchasing@acme-analytics.com
Date: Tue, 03 Feb 2026 11:30:22 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS private offer expiry + renewal steps for Acme Analytics

Thanks Sarah — looping in Neha (Legal) and Rishi (AE) from our side.

Rishi / Neha: Acme wants to move to a 24-month term and increase committed capacity by ~2.5x (they provided rough usage forecasts during the renewal call). Can you please:
- Neha: review the marketplace T&Cs quickly and flag any non-starters (we usually accept AWS marketplace flow but there are a couple of audit clauses they want tweaked)
- Rishi: confirm updated pricing for 24 months + capacity tiers so I can produce a line-item PO for Acme to approve

I've attached our updated proposal (v3) with proposed pricing and SKUs. Acme procurement — if you can confirm the invoicing preference (AWS monthly metered invoices vs. monthly RDW consolidated invoice) that will determine how we structure the PO.

I can prep a PO template referencing PO-987654 once pricing is confirmed. We have internal approval to offer a renewal discount for the 24-month commitment but need to finalize numbers today to meet Sarah's timeline.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0124

Attachment: AWS_PrivateOffer_Redwood_Proposal_v3.docx (stub)

From: Purchasing Team <purchasing@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: sarah.dunne@aws-partner.com
Date: Wed, 04 Feb 2026 08:09:14 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS private offer expiry + renewal steps for Acme Analytics

Marissa — thanks. For Acme: preferred flow is to have the PO reference the AWS PrivateOfferId and for AWS to invoice via marketplace (we need the marketplace billing records for internal chargeback). We can accept a monthly invoice cadence.

Two requests from procurement:
1) Please provide a line-item quote (final) showing monthly metering estimate and yearly total for the 24-month term
2) Provide a DocuSign link for the PO or a PDF we can upload to our procurement portal — we have an approval freeze on Fridays, so sooner is better.

Timelines: internal approvers need the DocuSign by EOD 2026-02-09 to avoid pushing the renewal to March.

Regards,
L. Park
Sourcing Manager, Acme Analytics
procurement@acme-analytics.com

Note: we will require the PO to reference PO-987654 exactly as provided by AWS.

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Feb 2026 09:42:03 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS private offer expiry + renewal steps for Acme Analytics

Marissa / Rishi — I reviewed the marketplace flow and prepared a short redline. Key asks:
- Narrow the audit window language (we require 30 days' notice for audits; marketplace default was 90)
- Data retention addendum: ensure logs/telemetry retention aligns with our customer data policy for Private deployments
- Liability cap: align to our standard 12-month cap for subscriptions

If Acme insists on custom contract language, we may need to shift to a direct contract path (slower). I attached the redline PDF — try to push the marketplace path first given the timeline.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Legal (Contracts), Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

2) Customer (Acme) issues PO referencing PO-987654 and uploads/executes DocuSign if required
